gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Bold, loose, widely spaced: Revalia strides. Noto Sans Kaithi, a plain sans whose lowercase fills the line like capitals, is the steady part that holds that stride in check.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Big, bold, and loose-limbed, Revalia takes the stage. Noto Sans Khojki, a sans-serif with wide exits and a large eye on every e, lets light back in beneath it.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-puritan: Revalia strides in, bold, expressive, and widely spaced. Puritan, a sans with rounded forms and oversized e and a counters, gives that swagger clean, approachable footing to sit on.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Whimsical and towering, Flavors gives diagonals the same heft as stems. Noto Sans Vithkuqi, a sans with open throats and a minimal cap-to-lowercase step, can sit at a modest size without crowding.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-ranade: Shantell Sans writes with one fixed nib width and a mouth wide as a tin lid. Ranade, a sans with stroke ends set far apart, leans gently thicker at the shoulders.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-matangi: Stenciled and tall, with wide bridges and a bold streak. Matangi, a sans with twine-like strokes and open rounded letters, supports Snowburst One, which earns its keep when big and short.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-miriam-libre: Expressive and bold, Snowburst One is a stencil with wide bridges between letters. Miriam Libre, a sans-serif with wire-like strokes and generous openings in the s, can run at a comfortable size.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-adlam-: Snowburst One is a bold stencil with wide bridges between its letters and an opening like a sprung paper clip. Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined, a sans-serif with little case height difference, steadies it.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-baline: Noto Sans Balinese gives every curved glyph a breathing space. Beneath the stencil boldness of Snowburst One, short ascenders and a modern build let paragraphs move along without any friction.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-devana: Loud, stenciled, and tall: that is Snowburst One, wide bridges and all. Noto Sans Devanagari, a sans with a compact skyline where capitals blend into lowercase, would read smoothly across paragraphs.
